newsitem.title: USA: PennCorp to buy Washington National - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: PennCorp to buy Washington National - WSJ.

text.p: Life insurer PennCorp Financial Group Inc is expected to buy a smaller insurance company called Washington National Corp for $400 million or $29.50 a share, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday.
The newspaper quoted "people close to the situation" as saying PennCorp would issue about $300 million in stock and pay $100 million in cash to make the purchase, which would close in early 1997.
The deal, which is to be announced on Friday, is to bolster PennCorp's earnings next year, it added.
The newspaper said PennCorp planned to merge most of Washington National's back office operations into its own while keeping most field offices.
It also planned to wring out about $25 million in expenses by cutting most of the insurer's corporate jobs, it said.
